about: Per-light decisions for the P06 scores REVERT (lighting_scores_apply.py, 'Per-light drift decisions'). One entry per drifted light the drift report could NOT attribute (class UNKNOWN = inferred hand edit). Attributed drift (RIG_LAMP_DROP etc.) is not decided here: revert that tool first.
how_to_decide: Set each 'decision' to keep / overwrite / fold (see that light's 'options'), then set status to DECIDED and decided_by to who decided (Gary). Leave row_hash alone: it pins the live row this decision is about; REVERT refuses if the light changed since.

options.overwrite: the row stays absent (same as keep)
